items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1957-multiple
items.q: Well, I remember a couple of them, Snag and myself and Tiny and a fellow on trombone named Eddie Ellis.

ctx.x: Charlie Cook, Greenland. Yeah. Now, who all was in the band? Can you remember a few of the people?

Well, I remember a couple of them, Snag and myself and Tiny and a fellow on trombone named Eddie Ellis. Eddie Ellis and they had the spore on alto. I believe you used to tell me about him, about his name today on the saxophone. Yeah, or Boone. Oh, Lester Boone.
